trials.solver_variable_description: Specifies the number of iterations for the Bullet contact solver. This is the native Bullet property btContactSolverInfo::m_numIterations. Default value is 10.

geometry.limitations: Both hull variants have zero margin and the same sharp box convex volume. They differ by redundant face/edge input points only. Original BulletBox has .04m collision margin and a specialized supporting-vertex algorithm; general convex collision behavior may differ, not claimed production-equivalent.
